retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome urban scene featuring a large bus wheel and candid figures, characterized by a top-aligned bold serif header.

recipe.visualDefinition: A grainy, high-contrast black and white photograph of an urban street scene dominated by the side of a vintage bus and a foreground car, featuring candid human subjects and a distinct top-left typographic header.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale mechanical elements (bus wheel) anchoring the left side
Candid human subjects framed by the bus windows and street architecture
Foreground car silhouette creating a horizontal base layer
Top-aligned typography integrated into the dark upper margin
coreInvariants: High-contrast monochrome palette with visible film grain
Layered urban depth using vehicle silhouettes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The bus occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame; human subjects are medium-scale in the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive black curve of the bus wheel in the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left text, follow the bus line down to the wheel, then move right across the car to the smiling faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blacks in the lower foreground car and upper bus frame provide structural negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal black for shadows and structural elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/light grey for highlights and skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone greys for mechanical textures and reflections.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast with crushed blacks and blown-out highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme stroke contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Slightly condensed proportions to fit the header width

composition.scale: small relative to frame, large relative to margin
composition.relationshipToImage: integrated into the dark upper band

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both primary and secondary information to maintain documentary consistency.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider slash between text elements

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme contrast and ball terminals of the era.
Captures the tight, high-contrast 70s display look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy monochrome photo of a 1970s London street scene. Include a large bus wheel in the lower left, a dark car silhouette in the foreground, and two people smiling from a bus entrance in the mid-ground. Ensure a dark horizontal band at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in a bold, high-contrast Didone serif font in the top-left corner, using white fill. Include a forward slash to separate the two main title elements.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochrome with high contrast?
Is the text positioned in the top-left corner?
Does the font exhibit extreme thick-to-thin stroke contrast?
Is the bus wheel a prominent visual anchor?

postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of a high-contrast serif font.
Ensure the composition is anchored by a large dark shape in the lower left.
Check that the overall mood is candid and documentary-style.
Confirm the monochrome palette has no color cast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Documentary Layout = (High-Contrast Monochrome Photo + Grain Texture) + (Top-Left Bold Didone Header) / (Mechanical Foreground Anchor)
